olga: quick hit: reproducible goroutine leak in Go generator stream when auth refresh + ctx cancel race. Put a tiny repro in sampleapp/generator/ctx-leak-repro.go. Anyone free to eyeball?

trevor: saw similar. The internal reader tries to re-establish transport on auth failure while user cancels ctx -> old reader sometimes blocks on sending to events chan.

sam: Can you paste the skeleton? curious about how Cancel vs Abort are used.

olga: minimal: open stream with caller ctx; reader loop does for stream.Next() { deliver } and we cancel ctx on SIGINT. If auth refresh occurs at same time, the transport reconnect path can race with cancel.

sam: Go SDK parity note: node/python have explicit Abort() + Resume(token). Go currently relies on ctx only which mixes "user intent" with "transport lifecycle". That ambiguity causes leaks.

trevor: short-term fix: internal wrapper should never close a shared channel twice. Use an internal cancelCtx for transport work and leave caller ctx untouched. Also set an atomic "abandoned" flag so resumed attempts don't try to send to closed receivers.

olga: I pushed a tiny patch that sets an abandoned atomic and cancels internal ctx on auth error; stops the goroutine reliably. Draft PR: #3121.

doc-bot: NOTE: docs/devex/go/README.md should include a "Streaming gotchas" section describing Abort vs ctx cancel.

sam: long-term: add explicit GeneratorStream.Abort() and Resume(token string) APIs and include a ResumeToken in AuthExpired events. Docs should warn: Resume may replay the last event; provide sequence_id for dedupe.

ci-bot: :robot_face: nightly-ci flaky: generator_stream_race_test failing intermittently (see https://ci/internal/stream-race-442).

trevor: I'll skip the flaky test and open an issue linking the PR and the test. Action items: trevor -> temp skip + issue; olga -> attach deterministic unit repro to PR; sam -> design API sketch for Abort/Resume and sequence_id; doc-bot -> add streaming gotchas note in README.

olga: thanks all, I'll follow up with the repro and add a sampleapp snippet showing how to use the abandoned flag pattern. :thumbsup:
